---
applyTo: "docs/**/*.md"
---

# Research documentation requirements

- Separate observed evidence from hypotheses and conclusions.
- Record the PEAK build/version, mod commit, host/client role, connection mode, region/server and test date.
- Replace App IDs, Steam IDs, usernames and local addresses with fingerprints or placeholders.
- Include the first divergent callback/state when documenting failures.
- State whether a result was static analysis, one-machine runtime, two-machine runtime, or physically offline LAN testing.
- Do not paste substantial decompiled game source. Summarize behavior and quote only the minimum signatures or snippets needed for interoperability notes.
